name: Dock
summary: macOS-style dock React component with grouped actions and a gliding active pill, installed via shadcn or copy-paste.
description: A motion component for React and Next.js: a macOS-style dock with grouped actions, separators and a gliding active pill. DockItem renders as a button when onClick is set, carries an active state and an aria-label; a size prop sets the item size in px (44 by default). Install with the shadcn CLI (shadcn add @beui/dock) or copy the source; needs the beUI theme tokens and the shared lib/ease.ts and lib/utils.ts files.
contains: macOS-style dock with grouped actions and a gliding active pill
parts: Dock, DockItem (active, onClick, aria-label), DockSeparator; size prop in px (default 44)
install: bunx --bun shadcn add @beui/dock, or copy the source
